management_remarks: TCS opened FY26 with accelerating deal conversion as prior-year TCV signings ramped up into billable revenue across BFSI, consumer, and energy verticals. Our AI.Cloud and cybersecurity practices grew over 22% year-on-year, driving strong gross margin resilience and EBIT margin of 24.6%. Attrition remained at an industry-low 12.1%, reflecting high employee engagement and over 45 million hours of advanced AI upskilling.
analyst_qa: When pressed on AI replacing entry-level billing hours, management acknowledged that automated code generation creates headwinds for traditional time-and-materials staffing models. Clients remain cautious and calibrated on outcome-based pricing clauses, making contract negotiations more complex and challenging. Discretionary spend in UK retail and European industrials is moderating and subject to volatile consumer sentiment.
